content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Stripe and PayPal offer a centralized commerce solution, but they operate in only 46 countries, excluding Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy provide an alternative, but they have their own set of restrictions and limitations, such as limited payment options and high fees. In contrast, COREMERCH offers a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that allows creators to deploy their own stack, configure payment options, and manage their products without relying on third-party platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have strict policies against operating in certain countries, which can lead to account suspensions and lost revenue. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy try to fill the gap, but their solutions often involve workarounds, such as using third-party payment processors or relying on manual payment verification. COREMERCH, on the other hand, is designed to operate globally, without relying on third-party platforms or payment processors, making it an ideal solution for creators in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge high transaction fees, ranging from 2.9% + 30¢ to 3.4% + 30¢ per transaction, while Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy charge even higher fees, often upwards of 5% + $0.30 per transaction. COREMERCH, on the other hand, charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it a more cost-effective solution for creators who want to maximize their revenue.
COREMERCH is not a workaround, but a permanent solution to the structural gap in the market.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of architecture ultimately depends on your specific needs and goals as a creator. If you're looking for a centralized solution, Stripe or PayPal may be a good fit. However, if you're in a restricted country or want more control over your commerce stack, COREMERCH is a better option. If you're looking for a scalable solution that can handle high volumes, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a great choice.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The most important question to ask is: Can I trust this solution to work for me, even if Stripe or PayPal is not available in my country? The answer is yes, with COREMERCH, you have full control over your digital commerce stack, and you can deploy your own solution, configure payment options, and manage your products without relying on third-party platforms.
By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can take control of your commerce and maximize your revenue.

You can also explore our other products, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), which offers a more basic solution, or the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack with COREMERCH, follow these steps: 1. Choose the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) that best fits your needs. 2. Deploy your stack using Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. 3. Configure your payment options using NOWPayments. 4. Load your products and set up automatic payment verification. 5. Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email deliverability. 6. Test your stack end-to-end before handoff. 7. Access our 30-day support channel for any questions or issues.
